title: Settings
subtitle: Platypus-wide settings, saved in ~/.local/share/platypus/settings.json.

language.heading: Language
language.description: The language of the launcher. System follows your desktop language. Applies right away, without a restart.
language.label: Language

folders.heading: Game folders

description.before: Where games install. A store's games go in their own subfolder of the default folder, for example
description.after: . Each game's “Install to…” step offers every folder here. Steam keeps using its own library folders.

folders.error: Platypus couldn't change the game folders.

prefixes.heading: Wine prefix folder
prefixes.description: Where new Wine prefixes are created, one folder per game. A game's own prefix setting still wins. Changing this folder does not move or delete existing prefixes. Games that already have a prefix keep it: Platypus pins it in their settings.
prefixes.label: Default Wine prefix folder
prefixes.browseTitle: Choose the default Wine prefix folder
prefixes.resetDone: Wine prefix folder reset to the default

cleanup.heading: Canceled downloads
cleanup.description: How long Platypus keeps the partially downloaded data of a canceled download before deleting it. The download can still be resumed during that time. 0 deletes it right away; a paused download is never touched.
cleanup.daysLabel: Days to keep canceled downloads' data

ratings.heading: Ratings, protection and anti-cheat data
ratings.description: Fetch ProtonDB ratings, PCGamingWiki protection facts and the anti-cheat list online. Off, Platypus shows what it saved before and asks nothing new.
ratings.label: Fetch game info online
ratings.on: Game info will be fetched online
ratings.creditWiki: Protection facts: PCGamingWiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 (pcgamingwiki.com). Used for this non-commercial launcher only.

artwork.heading: Sideloaded artwork lookup
artwork.description: Find cover and banner art online for games you added by hand, from Steam's public store. Off, Platypus keeps the placeholder and asks nothing new; art you already have stays.
artwork.label: Find artwork online
artwork.on: Sideloaded games will look up their art online
artwork.creditArt: Artwork: Steam store search and CDN images (store.steampowered.com).

gameInfo.heading: Sideloaded game info lookup
gameInfo.description: Find descriptions and details online for games you added by hand, from Steam, GOG and Lutris (IGDB). Off, Platypus keeps what it fetched before and asks nothing new.
gameInfo.label: Find game info online
gameInfo.on: Sideloaded games will look up their info online
gameInfo.creditInfo: Game info: Steam store details, GOG product descriptions and Lutris (IGDB) summaries.

chat.heading: Chat notifications
chat.description: Show a desktop notification for a new chat message when the Platypus window isn't focused. Clicking it opens the conversation. Off, new messages only raise the in-app toasts.
chat.label: Desktop notifications for chat
chat.on: Chat will notify on the desktop

prefixError: Platypus couldn't change the Wine prefix folder.
cleanupError: Platypus couldn't clean up those folders.
